headline: How to get Shadowbeak in Palworld 1.0
title: How to Get Shadowbeak in Palworld | Kitsun + Astegon No Longer Works | Breeding Guide
video_script: Want Shadowbeak in Palworld? Here is the catch. In Palworld one point zero, the old Kitsun plus Astegon combo no longer works. Shadowbeak now breeds true, so the only breeding combo is Shadowbeak plus Shadowbeak. That means you have to catch your first two in the wild. Head to Wildlife Sanctuary number three, where they spawn around level fifty to fifty five, or find them in the World Tree at around level eighty. Shadowbeak is a Dark type, so bring Dragon Pals. Once you have two, breed them for better passives. It is also a flying mount that boosts your Dark attacks. Did you know this changed? Comment below!
description: In Palworld 1.0 Shadowbeak breeds true - the only combo is Shadowbeak + Shadowbeak (the old Kitsun + Astegon recipe was removed). Catch your first ones at Wildlife Sanctuary No. 3 (Lv 50-55) or in the World Tree (Lv 80).
